description: Look up HTTP status codes: by exact code (e.g. 418, also non-standard ones like 499 or 524), by code prefix ("50"), or by words ("too many", "redirect post"), optionally limited to a class (1xx–5xx). Each result has the name, what it means, when to use it, common causes and the defining spec. Non-standard nginx/Cloudflare codes are only searched when "includeNonStandard" is set. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/http-status/

class.description: Only this class: 1 informational, 2 success, 3 redirection, 4 client error, 5 server error.

query.description: A code ("404"), code prefix ("5", "50") or search words. Empty = all codes (filtered by class).

name: http_status
title: HTTP status codes
